# Prime Time Healthcare

> > Prime Time Healthcare connects travel nurses and allied health professionals with temporary staffing opportunities nationwide, offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and full-service workforce solutions for healthcare facilities.

Prime Time Healthcare is a healthcare staffing agency specializing in travel nursing and allied health placements. The platform serves both job-seeking healthcare professionals seeking temporary contracts with flexible locations and healthcare facilities/employers requiring temporary staffing solutions through managed service provider partnerships.
